notes.title: Lots and lots of bug fixes!
notes.content:
Lots and lots of bug fixes!

- Improved stability on older devices
- Implemented fix for 'missing contacts' bug
- Fixed 'black screen' issue on older devices. 


Thank you for your help and feedback! :)

notes.title: LIMITED-TIME DISCOUNT: Accolades Celebration Event!
notes.content:
[h2]Accolades Celebration Event![/h2]

Here at Maze Theory we've been blown away by the praise and critical acclaim for Doctor Who: The Lonely Assassins! To welcome even more players into the community, we're running a week-long Accolades Celebration Event (until May 13th). 

[h3]Don't miss out - grab yourself a 30% discount now![/h3]

Are you brave enough to face the Weeping Angels?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39756181/b2d16d2fe377f30e77241294c4357bd47b206f5b.png[/img]

[h2]YOUR REVIEWS ARE IN....[/h2]

[list]
[*] Apple App Store: 4.6 / 5
[*] Google Play Store: 4.6 / 5 
[*] Steam: 9/10 
[/list]
[b]What. A. Ride.[/b]
"That was AMAZING. I just finished playing Doctor Who: The Lonely Assassins, and it was PERFECT. I’m a huge fan of the show, and my favorite episode is Blink, so this was right up my alley."

[b]This is a must have for fans of the Doctor[/b]
"Bonus if you are a fan of interactive fiction. For me this was reminiscent of the old school text adventures but on steroids. You basically get to be in an episode of Doctor Who by interacting with the phone in the app."

[b]Fantastic[/b]

[i]Thank you from everyone at Maze Theory and Kaigan Games :)[/i]
